content: The autonomous-task-brain skill implements a standardized closed-loop autonomous task management workflow: perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new, repeated, or failed tasks) → retrieve (find optimal solutions from local skills, historical sessions, memory engines, and GitHub) → decide (select execute/suggest/skip actions based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences) → execute (auto create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks) → review (record execution results, update knowledge base to improve future performance).
